blindness_caveat: This record was created from public company announcements and independent press coverage before any Caterpillar SEC filing corpus or Helix Caterpillar output was fetched or inspected. Search-result snippets were visible during research, but no SEC filing text was used. The list is a deliberately scoped recent-transaction set rather than a claim of exhaustive Caterpillar corporate history.
note: Scoped to selected publicly documented transactions from 2017 through the study date (2026-09-18). This set intentionally includes several distinct mechanisms: a small private-company acquisition, selected-asset/team acquisition, acquisition of a seller's operating division, technology-company acquisitions, and a divestiture of foreign subsidiaries. Yard Club and Marble Robot were relatively small and may not have produced standalone 8-K disclosure. Weir Oil & Gas was announced in 2020 and later operated as SPM Oil & Gas. The Russian-asset transfer was reported from Russian company filings and may not use conventional voluntary divestiture language. RPMGlobal and Skycatch occurred in 2026 and are inside the runner's declared end date but after Caterpillar's latest annual filing available at the study date.
